summary: Operator enterprise topology: OpenShift with 3 control and 2 worker nodes (each worker 16 GB RAM, 4 CPUs, 128 GB disk, 3000 IOPS). Pods: controller web/task, hub web/API/Redis, 2 hub content, 2 hub worker, EDA API and scheduler, 2 each EDA activation worker, default worker and event stream, gateway, 2 mesh ingress; external database, Redis and object storage.
